question: Will I receive an email confirmation?
answer: Once you register online, you will receive a confirmation email immediately from Race Roster. Please provide your primary email address.

question: Can I register on the day of the race?
answer: No. However, if there are spots remaining at the close of registration, you may register at Packet Pickup.

question: Can a race entry be transferred to someone else?
answer:
Yes. If you would like to transfer your registration to a new participant, please click the transfer link Half & 10k, Full, Half & Relay. Once logged into your Race Roster account, click “Transfer to a New Participant” in the blue box and complete the steps as directed.

Please note, the NEW participant will pay a $10 transfer fee. The original participant will NOT receive a refund. The exchange of monies is between the original participant and the new participant.

Transfers close 45 days before each race date. Transfers have closed for the Acme Fresh Market Foundation 8k & 1 Mile.

question: How do I transfer sub-events/switch events? (example: move from the full Marathon to the half)
answer:
If you would like to transfer your registration to another sub-event, please click the transfer link August, September. Once logged into your Race Roster account, click “Transfer to a New Sub-Event” in the blue box and complete the steps as directed.

Please note there will be a $10 fee to transfer to a new sub-event + any applicable change in registration fees.

Transfers close 45 days before each race date. Transfers have closed for the Acme Fresh Market Foundation 8k & 1 Mile.

question: I was injured after registering for the race. Can I get a refund or defer until next year or a different event?
answer:
Did you purchase registration insurance? If so, use this link to file a claim with the registration insurance company. Inquires can be sent to support@protecht.com.

If not, we have a no refund or deferment policy.

question: Why do you ask for Sex and Gender during registration?
answer:
The inclusion of sex-related questions on the Akron Marathon Race Series Registration Form aligns with USA Track & Field and World Athletics, our governing bodies, which uses sex for competition and awarding prize money and awards. This ensures compliance with sporting regulations and maintains fairness in competition.

Simultaneously, the question about gender identity aims to promote inclusivity within the Akron Marathon Race Series community, reflecting a commitment to recognizing and respecting diverse gender identities. While sex is a regulatory necessity for prize distribution, gender identity ensures a welcoming and representative environment for all participants. Men’s and Women’s Divisions will be classified by sex.

Participants who elect to compete in the Non-Binary Division will be eligible for placement awards for 1st – 3rd.
